title: POST /api/v1/pairings/{pairing}/proposals request
description: A device (the signer site's pairing page, or the phone app) sends its key for the open pairing `{pairing}`, with the tag made with the whole code. Without a sign-in: the signer site has none, and the tag, which only the code makes, is what the machine checks. The cloud takes the first proposal for an open pairing; another (`pairing_closed`, 409), or one for a pairing that isn't open (`pairing_closed`, 404), changes nothing. Allowed from the signer site's origin (CORS).
